title: Targeted Artificial Intelligence Language mOdel Recommendations for Chronic Kidney Disease
official: Large Language Model-Generated Messages to Improve Guideline-Directed Medical Therapy in Chronic Kidney Disease
summary:
This study tests whether artificial intelligence messages to clinicians improve the use of recommended medicines in adults with diabetes and chronic kidney disease. The tool reviews existing medical records and places patient-specific recommendations in internal Epic Huddle notes before endocrinology or cardiology visits at Mass General Brigham.

Eligible visits during approximately 3-6 months before implementation are compared with visits during approximately 3-6 months afterward among the same clinicians, without randomization. Outcomes include medication optimization within 30 days, message delivery, and short-term safety. Patients are not contacted, and all treatment decisions remain with clinicians and patients.
conditions: Chronic Kidney Disease Due to Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus

interventions.name: LLM CKD GDMT Clinical Decision Support

criteria:
Patient Inclusion Criteria

* Age 18 years or older.
* Scheduled outpatient visit with a participating endocrinology or cardiology provider at Mass General Brigham.
* At least one prior clinic visit in the same specialty as the index visit within the Mass General Brigham system in the past 2 years.
* Diagnosis of diabetes mellitus, either type 1 or type 2.
* Chronic kidney disease defined by either an estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) below 60 mL/min/1.73 m² on at least two measurements separated by at least 3 months, or a urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio (UACR) of at least 30 mg/g on at least two measurements separated by at least 3 months.

Patient Exclusion Criteria

* Dialysis or end-stage kidney disease.
* Prior kidney transplant.
* Polycystic kidney disease.
* Current enrollment in hospice or receipt of palliative care.
* Active cancer on chemotherapy.
* Pregnancy.
* eGFR below 20 mL/min/1.73 m² on the most recent laboratory assessment.

Provider Inclusion Criteria

* Endocrinology or cardiology attending physician, fellow or resident physician supervised by an endocrinology or cardiology attending physician, or advanced practice provider.
* Provides outpatient care to adults with diabetes in a participating Mass General Brigham endocrinology or cardiology clinic.
* Identified in collaboration with divisional, service-line, or clinic leadership as eligible.

Provider Exclusion Criteria

\- Explicit request not to participate after receiving information about the study.
